rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the hidden true nature
verb indicating the emergence of a state

items.question: What state arises from knowing the hidden true nature?
premises: There exists a hidden true nature.
That hidden true nature can be known.
Knowing it produces a resulting state.
items.inference: Knowing the hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
uncertainties: The precise referent of taṃ depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
